# QuolyTech

QuolyTech is a digital technology studio based in Tiranë, Albania.

## Positioning

QuolyTech builds websites, mobile applications, AI agents, custom software and digital solutions that help businesses operate, grow and improve their online presence.

## Core Services

- Web Development (Custom Websites, Web Applications, React, Next.js, WordPress, PHP, MySQL)
- AI Agent Development (24/7 Support Agents, Lead Qualification, Internal Knowledge Search, Workflow Automation)
- Mobile App Development (iOS & Android Cross-Platform Applications, React Native)
- Custom Software Development (Operational Dashboards, Admin Portals, REST APIs)
- Business Automation (System Integrations, Webhooks, Data Pipelines)
- SEO & Digital Growth (Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, Schema.org Data)
- Branding & Digital Identity (Logo Systems, Visual Guidelines, Typography Tokens)

## Location

Tiranë, Albania
